ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路的路況正常。

ex.en: The accident took place on the highway.
ex.zh: 事故發生在高速公路上。

ex.en: I enjoyed driving on the new highway.
ex.zh: 我很享受在新的高速公路上開車。

ex.en: We should cancel the hike.
ex.zh: 我們應該取消這次健行。

ex.en: We went for a hike in Yangmingshan.
ex.zh: 我們去陽明山健行。

ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.
ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就不去爬山了。

ex.en: We plan to go hiking tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們打算明天去健行。

ex.en: Workers are angry about the price hike.
ex.zh: 員工對漲價很不滿。

ex.en: The bank announced an interest rate hike.
ex.zh: 銀行宣布調升利率。

ex.en: The trail is popular with hikers on weekends.
ex.zh: 這條步道週末很受健行客歡迎。

ex.en: Two hikers got lost on the mountain yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天有兩名登山客在山上迷路。

ex.en: The company has a strict hierarchy.
ex.zh: 這家公司階級分明。

ex.en: She quickly moved up the corporate hierarchy.
ex.zh: 她在公司的階層中迅速升遷。

ex.en: Historically, sales are lowest in February.
ex.zh: 從過去來看，二月的銷售量最低。

ex.en: The area has historically been a trading center.
ex.zh: 這個地區自古以來就是貿易中心。

ex.en: The data reveals a hitherto unknown problem.
ex.zh: 這些資料揭露了一個至今未知的問題。

ex.en: The company is entering a hitherto untapped market.
ex.zh: 公司正在進軍一個至今尚未開發的市場。

ex.en: The histogram shows the age distribution of our customers.
ex.zh: 這張直方圖顯示我們顧客的年齡分布。

ex.en: Each bar in the histogram represents a price range.
ex.zh: 直方圖裡的每一根長條代表一個價格區間。

ex.en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
ex.zh: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

ex.en: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.
ex.zh: 富士山是日本最高的山。

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶收取較高的貸款利息。

ex.en: The product is of high quality.
ex.zh: 這項產品品質很高。

ex.en: The bird flew high in the sky.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在高空中飛翔。

ex.en: Don't set your goals too high.
ex.zh: 別把目標訂得太高。

ex.en: The old man was almost hit by a car.
ex.zh: 那位老人差點被車撞到。

ex.en: I hate when the driver in front of me hits the brakes for no reason.
ex.zh: 我很討厭前面的車無緣無故突然踩煞車。

ex.en: An earthquake, 8.9 on the Richter scale, hits Japan and causes a massive tsunami.
ex.zh: 規模 8.9 的強烈地震襲擊日本，引發大海嘯。

ex.en: The typhoon hit Taiwan last night.
ex.zh: 颱風昨晚侵襲台灣。

ex.en: Sales hit a record high this year.
ex.zh: 今年銷售額創下新高。

ex.en: We finally hit our target last month.
ex.zh: 我們上個月終於達成目標。

hit.zh: 熱門的人或事物、成功之作

ex.en: Her new song was a big hit.
ex.zh: 她的新歌大受歡迎。

ex.en: The product became a hit with young people.
ex.zh: 這項產品在年輕人之間大受歡迎。

ex.en: Japan is highly competitive in high technology industries.
ex.zh: 日本在高科技產業中競爭力很強。

ex.en: Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
ex.zh: 挪威位於北歐，是高度發展的國家。

ex.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
ex.zh: 我知道不太可能有人認識我。

ex.en: Her new novel has been highly praised.
ex.zh: 她的新小說備受好評。

ex.en: My manager speaks highly of your work.
ex.zh: 我的經理對你的工作評價很高。

ex.en: I highly recommend this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我非常推薦這家餐廳。

ex.en: I'll never tell anyone where I've hidden the treasure.
ex.zh: 我永遠不會告訴任何人我把寶藏藏在哪裡。

ex.en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
ex.zh: 她躲在門後，屏住呼吸。

ex.en: She hid the gift under the bed.
ex.zh: 她把禮物藏在床底下。

ex.en: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
ex.zh: 他隱藏情緒，假裝很熱心。

ex.en: We often hide our thoughts in front of others.
ex.zh: 我們常在別人面前隱藏自己的想法。

ex.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
ex.zh: 一座歷史地標已修復完成，即將重新開放。

ex.en: This is a city of real historical value.
ex.zh: 這是一座極具歷史價值的城市。

ex.en: Many important historical events took place 7000 years B.C.
ex.zh: 西元前七千年左右發生了許多重要的歷史事件。

ex.en: The river's on the other side of the hill.
ex.zh: 河在山丘的另一邊。

ex.en: The building on the hill is our school.
ex.zh: 山丘上那棟建築就是我們學校。

ex.en: It's good exercise to climb hills.
ex.zh: 爬山是很好的運動。

ex.en: Historians disagree about the causes of the war.
ex.zh: 歷史學家對這場戰爭的起因看法不一。

ex.en: My uncle is a historian at the university.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是大學裡的歷史學家。

historic.zh: 歷史性的、有歷史意義的

ex.en: It was a historic decision.
ex.zh: 這是一個歷史性的決定。

ex.en: He set out on his historic voyage.
ex.zh: 他展開了那趟具有歷史意義的航行。

historic.zh: 歷史悠久的、古老的（建築、城市）

ex.en: There are many famous historic buildings in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 京都有很多著名的歷史建築。

ex.en: This is a historic city.
ex.zh: 這是一座歷史古城。

ex.en: Would you give me a hint?
ex.zh: 你可以給我一點提示嗎？

ex.en: She dropped a hint that she wanted a new phone.
ex.zh: 她暗示她想要一支新手機。

ex.en: There's a hint of garlic in the sauce.
ex.zh: 醬汁裡有一點蒜味。

ex.en: I noticed a hint of sadness in his voice.
ex.zh: 我察覺到他的聲音裡帶著一絲悲傷。

ex.en: What are you hinting at?
ex.zh: 你在暗示什麼？

ex.en: My manager hinted that I might get a promotion.
ex.zh: 我的主管暗示我可能會升職。

ex.en: He got a hip ultrasound.
ex.zh: 他做了髖部超音波檢查。

ex.en: She put her hands on her hips.
ex.zh: 她雙手叉腰。

ex.en: This is a hip neighborhood with lots of cafés.
ex.zh: 這是一個有很多咖啡廳的時髦街區。

ex.en: He always wears hip clothes.
ex.zh: 他總是穿得很時髦。

ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.
ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就不去爬山了。

ex.en: We plan to go hiking tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們打算明天去健行。

ex.en: She is wearing hiking boots.
ex.zh: 她穿著登山鞋。

ex.en: How come you know so much about Japanese history?
ex.zh: 你怎麼對日本歷史這麼了解？

ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.
ex.zh: 太空競賽是歷史上令人振奮的時期。

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

ex.en: Do you have a history of heart disease in your family?
ex.zh: 你家族有心臟病史嗎？

ex.en: The company has a long history of making bikes.
ex.zh: 這家公司製造腳踏車的歷史很悠久。

ex.en: The highlight of the trip was seeing the sunrise.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行最精彩的是看日出。

ex.en: Here are the highlights of last night's game.
ex.zh: 以下是昨晚比賽的精華片段。

ex.en: The report highlights the need for more training.
ex.zh: 報告強調需要更多的培訓。

ex.en: Highlight the key words in yellow.
ex.zh: 用黃色標出關鍵字。

ex.en: If he's fluent in English, I'll hire him.
ex.zh: 如果他英文說得流利，我就雇用他。

ex.en: That company hires people without regard to race, religion, or nationality.
ex.zh: 這家公司雇人不分種族、宗教或國籍。

ex.en: Zailaiba Bar is hiring waiters; are you interested?
ex.zh: 「再來吧」酒吧在徵服務生，你有興趣嗎？

ex.en: I would like to hire a car.
ex.zh: 我想租一輛車。

ex.en: We hired bikes and rode around the lake.
ex.zh: 我們租了腳踏車繞著湖騎。
